scope: Inherited static-shell and reviewed generated vendor-IP assumptions; not independent board-interface timing or vendor CDC correctness signoff
basis: Exact ports observed in the existing routed U55C platform checkpoint on 2026-11-08. These management, reset, UART and HBM safety interfaces belong to the preimplemented static shell, outside the SysBase kernel interface. Their inherited board-interface timing assumptions are adopted for this platform version only.

blp_inherited_cdc.reason: Exact crossing wholly within the fixed BLP platform. Adopt delivered PCIe lane control/reset, debug FIFO, JTAG and ICAP-management CDC assumptions for this platform UUID and Vivado build. This is inherited vendor-platform risk, not an independent proof of CDC correctness.

hmss_xpm_fifo_data.reason: Exact HMSS XPM dual-clock FIFO memory data path with Max Delay Datapath Only constraint. Adopt vendor FIFO pointer/enable synchronization contract; require current routed setup, hold and bus-skew closure. This exception does not cover arbitrary clock-enable or application CDC paths.

hmss_thermal_reset.reason: Vendor DRAM_STAT_CATTRIP thermal-trip status fans out to parallel four-stage proc_sys_reset trees in SLR0/SLR2 on hbm_aclk. Adopt vendor thermal shutdown and initialization behavior; no claim that generic reset fanout or data reconvergence is safe.

ucs_startup_gating.reason: Vendor Startup_Done gates kernel00/kernel01 ECCLK and the HBM BUFG clock enable. Kernel ECCLK uses CE_TYPE ASYNC with scoped false paths; generated HBM BUFGCE uses CE_TYPE SYNC. Assume clock gating changes during reset/startup and then remains stable, as required by delivered platform control.

ucs_rate_update.reason: Vendor eight-bit Rate_int capture follows a four-stage synchronized update toggle and max-delay constraints. Management software must hold Rate_In stable through the update transaction. This adopts the delivered clock-throttling control contract.

ucs_frequency_measurement.reason: Vendor frequency-counter measurement buses use two-stage XPM array synchronizers. Counter data is coherent only after measurement stops and settling following the synchronized done indication; no coherence claim while source counters increment.

blp_reset_logic_methodology.reason: Exact full associated cell/pin sets are wholly within the delivered fixed BLP: PCIe, management/JTAG/debug and P2P FIFO reset/control logic. Some sinks are ordinary state/control registers. Adopt the vendor reset/glitch behavior as an inherited platform assumption; this is not a proof of glitch-free reset or synchronizer-only fanout.

blp_gt_clock_delay_group.reason: Exact fixed PCIe GTYE4_CHANNEL TXOUTCLK[0..3] drivers in channel_container[24..27] retain the delivered CLOCK_DELAY_GROUP placement. Adopt the delivered hard-transceiver clock architecture; no new clock-delay grouping or independent phase-safety proof.

blp_debug_lut_clock.reason: Exact fixed BLP soft-BSCAN update LUT remains in the delivered JTAG clock tree. Retain the vendor debug-clock architecture as an inherited glitch/phase assumption, not a false-positive classification; routed numeric timing still must pass.

blp_clock_relationships.reason: Exact delivered PCIe-reference/GT/pipe and MDM/JTAG/DMA clock relationships and constraint scopes are retained. No-common-node, scoped clock groups, synchronous-domain masking and overridden max-delay concerns remain vendor-platform assumptions; their safety is not independently proven. Adoption requires byte-identical static DCP, exact platform/tool identity, complete per-endpoint CDC review, and strict current numeric setup/hold/bus-skew gates. The inherited global clock groups can affect DMA/peripheral clocks also used by ULP. This class grants no application or regenerated ULP crossing exception: each current detailed crossing still needs its own exact review.

detailed_cdc_aggregate.reason: This objectless aggregate adds no endpoint exemption. It is accepted only because release independently requires all current detailed report_cdc -all_checks_per_endpoint findings to be individually reviewed with exact endpoint/synchronizer signatures; any unreviewed crossing blocks release.

blp_pcie_status_multicycle.reason: Adopt the authentic installed PCIe IP CFGPHYLINKDOWN setup-start4/hold-start3 multicycle contract preserved byte-for-byte in the delivered static DCP. The exact-pin routed setup and hold must both be nonnegative and report those exact constraints. The refreshed methodology diagnostic disagrees with the constrained timing report; its internal cause remains unresolved. The 4 ns difference is consistent with generic-versus-specific CFG exception context but is only an inference, not a proven tool defect. No new/relaxed constraint or negative numeric path waiver is permitted.

blp_perst_delay_assumption.reason: Exact PCIe asynchronous PERST input is one of the independently checked seven inherited static input-delay omissions. No new port, count, name or platform identity is allowed; external reset timing remains a vendor board-interface assumption.

vendor_constraint_query_efficiency.reason: The exact inherited IRQ hierarchical pin query has a runtime-efficiency diagnostic. Retain query semantics; this does not approve the crossing itself. Current IRQ selector membership and actual registered source/synchronizer structure are reviewed separately.

vendor_duplicate_generated_clocks.reason: Exact descriptions repeat identical generated-clock command, source and line for delivered axi_jtag/BSIP clocks. Retain the delivered duplicate replay; changed waveform/source/division/definition cannot match this exception.

registered_kernel_irq_vendor_ingress.reason: Exact routed registered SysBase level source into inherited unmarked q_i ingress then two marked ASYNC_REG stages. Positive source/output/direct-net/clock/selector checks, authentic AXI INTC input cut with null slack, and unexcepted positive final-pair setup/hold are mandatory. Adopt delivered vendor ingress/synchronizer behavior under the reviewed enable/ack/pending-level limits; no arbitrary short-pulse delivery or analog MTBF proof.

runtime_scalable_primary_clock.reason: Exact primary MMCM compiled default300MHz versus150MHz runtime target. Adopt authenticated generated UCS startup gating and installed XRT2.19.194 DRP/lock/load contract. Actual XCLBIN DATA_CLK/system metadata150, routed6.667ns and matching loaded runtime driver are required. A different-UUID program must succeed and be followed by healthy/idle/exactUUID/primary150 checks before any host launch. No failed-load isolation or independent frequency-counter guarantee is claimed.

blp_firewall_error_aggregation.reason: Exact new fixed-shell ctrl_user/gen_mi mi_r_error_i source into the same two-stage aggregated-management IRQ relies on delivered vendor firewall error-aggregation behavior. This is explicit static-platform adoption, not equivalence to the prior reported source or proof of sticky/glitch-free aggregation. The reason for different reported STARTPOINT selection is unproven. No new application endpoint is covered.

blp_mdm_debug_completion.reason: Five exact new fixed-shell MDM completion_block sources into the same BSCAN/TDO destinations rely on delivered vendor debug protocol and clock-enable phase assumptions. This does not prove coherence, sampling safety or equivalence to the prior ERT MicroBlaze source. Changed representative selection is only an inference; why the reporter selected another source is unproven. No new application endpoint is covered.

irq_input_cut.scope: Delivered AXI INTC first synchronizer input cut. q_i is inherited ingress; only intr_ff0 to intr_ff1 is the marked, timed two-stage synchronizer. No positive slack is claimed for the cut input.

runtime_clock_contract.scope: Authentic platform static MMCM default300 and XRT runtime target150; primary generated constraint and DATA_CLK topology must match requested150. Normal successful2RP startup resets/disables kernel clock, programs DRP and waits lock, then enables UCS and calibrates HBM. Failed/interrupted programming is not guaranteed isolated and prohibits host launch until a fresh explicit validated state is established.
runtime_clock_contract.measurement_limit: Clock configuration and MMCM lock are checked; topology scaling uses verify=0, so this is not an independent physical frequency-counter measurement.
